visual.general_description: Twelve-lead grayscale electrocardiogram tracing on a fine square grid.
visual.detailed_description: Twelve vertically stacked horizontal dark traces are labeled I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF and V1 through V6 at the left. Repeated narrow spikes and broader waves span each row. Several lower precordial rows show substantial baseline undulation between spikes, especially V3–V5. Fine grid squares cover the background; small rectangular calibration-shaped pulses appear at the far right. No numerical heart rate, printed paper speed or voltage gain is visible. There are no colored arrows or panel letters.

evidence.quote: Given his chest pain and tachyarrhythmia, cardiac enzymes were ordered: troponin I was elevated to 1.2 ng/mL (reference range <0.04 ng/mL), suggestive of myocardial injury.
An electrocardiogram revealed ST depressions in the lateral leads and non-specific ST-T changes (Figure 1).

clinical_significance.statement: Authors interpret lateral ST depressions with elevated troponin as myocardial injury prompting the ACS workup; this is source interpretation rather than an independent image diagnosis.

limitations: ST-depression locations are author-caption claims, without independent calibrated measurement or a new rhythm diagnosis.
The later post-angiography clinical heart rate 130–140 bpm is not a printed ECG measurement and is not applied to this image.

visual.general_description: Single grayscale coronary angiographic projection of the source-described left coronary system.
visual.detailed_description: A broad dark vessel enters the upper-left field, extends almost horizontally across the upper image, then branches into multiple tapering curved vessels through the center and lower field. A long thick branch descends centrally and bends rightward along the lower image, with fine branches at its end; another diagonal branch extends toward the viewer-right edge. Faint overlapping bony and soft-tissue shadows form the background. A horizontal footer ruler has ticks and the label cm, with no legible numbered endpoints. No lesion calipers, colored arrows or panel letters are visible.

visual.general_description: Single grayscale coronary angiographic projection of the source-described right coronary system.

A thick branching vessel descends along the viewer-left center, forms a broad lower loop or C-shaped bend, and continues rightward into thinner branching vessels. Faint bony and soft-tissue shadows overlap the background. A horizontal footer ruler has ticks and the label cm, with no legible numbered endpoints; a dotted line runs along the top border. No lesion calipers, colored arrows or panel letters are visible.
